text: Eating well, staying active, and getting enough rest are the foundations of a healthy life. A balanced diet, rich in fruits, vegetables, and whole grains, gives your body the energy it needs. Regular exercise, even a daily thirty-minute walk, strengthens your heart and boosts your mood. Equally important is sleep; aiming for seven to eight hours each night helps your brain recover and focus. However, health is not just physical. Taking care of your mental health matters too. This means managing stress, talking about your feelings, and making time for hobbies. Finally, try to keep a healthy work-life balance. Set clear boundaries between work and personal time, and remember that rest is productive. Small, consistent choices every day make the biggest difference.
